violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Dried food debris at Quesadilla cutter. *Replaced with clean cutter immediately.--Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Minimal black debris at edges of ice chute at drive through soda machine. -Pink residue at sides of ice chute at public soda dispenser.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Residue at floor edges/below shelves of walk in cooler. -Some trash/debris in walk in freezer.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Scoop laying with handle in sprinkles at drive through food bin.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Debris/residue at top of lids to bulk storage bins. -Residue at handles of both 2 door warmers.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Residue on floor at walk in cooler floor. -Debris below soda bibs, and trash bags piled near back door.
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
